title: Zainab ke Dulaarey
body:
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Sehroz ki thi tashnalabi dhasht me phir bhi
Murjhaye huwe chehrou pe ek taazagi aayi
Jab ran ki riza pa gaye Zainab ke dularey
<<MINI>>
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey....
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Pyaasou ne tassavur me bhi darya ko na dekha
Asgher ki taraf dekh ke joh maa ne kaha tha
Us azm pe qayam rahe zainbab ke dularey
<<MINI>>
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey....
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Dono ki wega dekh ke hairaa’n teh sitamger
Ek sath nazer aane lage jaffer o Hyder
Jab leke bardhe neemchay Zainab ke dularey
<<MINI>>
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey....
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Dhoke se sitamgaar ne humley kiyue jisdum
Donu ke badan zakhmi huwe jaatey they paiham
Tar khoon me hone lage Zainab ke dularey
<<MINI>>
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey....
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Ankhou se rawa’n hota tha ashkoun ka samander
Maidaa’n me gaye sha-he-deen Abbas ko leker
Jab zein se zameen par girey Zainab ke dulare
<<MINI>>
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey....
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Laashoun ko liye khaimey me aaye shah e wala
Yeh kehtey huwe binte Ali ne kiya sajda
Farz apna ada kargaye Zainab ke dularey
<<MINI>>
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey....
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Khaimey me kamaal us ghadi ek hasr tha barpa
Maa kehti thi sub se ke gaye chord ke tanha
Zainab ki duayein liye Zainab ke dularey
<<MINI>>
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey....
Shabbir pa qurbaa'n huwe Zainab ke dulaarey
Yun wada wafa kargaye Zainab ke dulaarey
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz Mohsin kamaal
